name: deepwind-harness
description: Evidence-gated engineering workflows and DeepWind MCP access for complex work.

interface.longDescription: Plan, adversarially review, and coordinate multi-workstream engineering with discovery, explicit quality gates, isolated specialists, and evidence-based delivery. The plugin also bundles the DeepWind MCP endpoint; each user authenticates through the supported host flow and controls tool approvals.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a harness plan for this multi-workstream engineering goal.
Review this harness plan for missing evidence and execution risks.
Coordinate the current harness project with isolated specialists.
